title: Japan Underfoot — 108-Piece Manhole Art Sticker Pack
descriptionHtml:
Japan's most unexpected street art, collected in one 108-piece pack.

Japan Underfoot turns the colorful creature-filled utility covers found across Japan into a deep assortment of circular decals. Every design feels like a tiny travel find: local scenery, bold linework, Japanese lettering, and a different cast built into each cover.

What is included

  • One 108-piece multicolor sticker assortment
  • Individually cut self-adhesive vinyl decals
  • Circular Japanese manhole-art designs
  • A wide mix of characters, color palettes, and regional-style backgrounds

Where they work

Apply to clean, smooth, dry surfaces such as laptops, notebooks, binders, luggage, phone cases, storage cases, and hand-washed bottles. Press each sticker firmly from the center outward after placing.

The stickers are sold as one complete assortment. Designs average about 1.5 inches across, with minor variation from piece to piece. The surface is water-resistant, but the pack has not been represented as dishwasher-safe. Minor differences in color, print alignment, and die-cut edges may occur. Clean and dry the surface before applying.

Returns

If your order is lost in transit, arrives damaged or defective, contains the wrong item, or is materially different from its description, contact us with your order number and available photos. View the full policy.
